title: #085. Minimum-Disruption Rescheduling
subtitle: Repair a disrupted binary shift schedule while minimizing Hamming distance from the baseline plan plus assignment costs.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { schedule, hammingDistance, totalObjective }.
judge.m3: Worker {p0} is unavailable in slot {p1} and cannot be assigned.
judge.m4: Worker {p0} is assigned {p1} shifts, exceeding maxShifts ({p2}).
judge.m5: Slot {p0} has {p1} assigned workers, expected exact demand {p2}.
judge.m6: Reported hammingDistance ({p0}) does not match actual flips from baseline ({p1}).
judge.m7: Reported totalObjective ({p0}) does not match computed disruption plus worker cost ({p1}).
judge.m8: Valid repair schedule, but totalObjective ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
